activity.notes: Joseph María was a Guapite Karankawa leader whose coalition attacked the Andry expedition and Mission Rosario in 1778 and negotiated with the Spanish in 1787. This records his documented period of prominent leadership, not a formal pan-Karankawa kingship. His influence declined after the July 1787 crisis; he was reported killed by Lipan Apaches in 1789. He is distinct from similarly named nineteenth-century Karankawa leaders.
